Materialize the current cohort as a persistent DuckDB database

Source: R/duckdb_backend.R
materialize_cohort_duckdb.Rd

Uses the canonical selection, hierarchy, three-index, table-linkage, and projection contracts. The complete database is built and validated in same-filesystem staging before it atomically replaces the one current database.

Usage

materialize_cohort_duckdb(
  src_name = NULL,
  db_path = NULL,
  icd_filter_path = NULL,
  cohort_sql = NULL,
  setup_sql = NULL,
  cohort_fn = NULL,
  direct_ids_path = NULL,
  cohort = NULL,
  no_filter = FALSE,
  key = NULL,
  import_scope = NULL,
  allow_unmatched_ids = FALSE,
  window_sql = NULL,
  window_fn = NULL,
  schema = NULL,
  tables = NULL,
  memory_limit = NULL,
  threads = NULL,
  temp_directory = NULL,
  table_chunk_rows = 5e+06,
  validate_columns = FALSE,
  ignore_errors = TRUE,
  store_rejects = TRUE,
  use_parquet_cache = TRUE,
  base_dir = NULL,
  raw_data_root = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  show_progress = TRUE
)

Arguments

src_name

Registered source name.

db_path

Destination DuckDB file. Defaults to ehr_paths() output.

icd_filter_path

ICD-code CSV or RDS file with an icd_code column and an icd_version column (9 or 10). icd_version is required for MIMIC-IV and eICU; for MIMIC-III it may be omitted (ICD-9 is assumed) and ICD-10 rows are excluded. A code matches only in its stated version.

cohort_sql

Final selection query; use setup_sql for dependencies.

setup_sql

Optional ordered SQL statements or files.

cohort_fn

Function or function name returning identifiers.

direct_ids_path

CSV, CSV.GZ, Parquet, or RDS identifier file.

cohort

Bundled named cohort.

no_filter

Select the whole available source.

key

Explicit configured hierarchy key.

import_scope

Patient, hospital, ICU, or configured hierarchy key.

allow_unmatched_ids

Permit a partially unmatched selection when at least one identifier matches.

window_sql, window_fn

Optional hierarchy builder override.

schema

Destination schema inside DuckDB.

tables

Optional bounded table subset.

memory_limit, threads, temp_directory

Optional DuckDB resource limits.

table_chunk_rows

Row threshold for chunked table builds; see import_cohort_general().

validate_columns

If TRUE, validate raw column types before building; see import_cohort_general(). Off by default.

ignore_errors, store_rejects

Raw CSV error tolerance and reject visibility; see import_cohort_general().

use_parquet_cache

If TRUE (default), a table whose raw CSV has already been cached as parquet by cache_raw_parquet_duckdb() is read from that parquet instead of re-parsing CSV. Tables without a cached parquet still fall back to CSV. Set FALSE to always read CSV.

base_dir

Project root.

raw_data_root

Optional parent of the source-specific raw directory.

overwrite

Safely replace the current completed artifact?

show_progress

Print aggregate progress.

Value

Invisibly returns the normalized plan, reports, status, path, and csv_reject_report.

Details

A separate, opt-in path from run_one_source() (the canonical pipeline entry point): it skips Parquet and PostgreSQL entirely for local, Postgres-free access to the raw cohort tables. Concept extraction and harmonization are PostgreSQL-only and do not run against this database - use import_cohort_general() + run_db() instead if you need those.

When the cohort is selected by ICD code (a named ICD cohort such as "scid", or a raw icd_filter_path), the exact code list that defined the cohort is also published as a reference table, d_<name>_icds (e.g. d_scid_icds for the bundled SCI cohort; a name derived from the file's basename for a raw icd_filter_path). SQL-based cohorts (e.g. "sepsis3") have no ICD list and get no such table.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
materialize_cohort_duckdb("mimic_iv_demo", db_path = "data/duckdb/mimic_iv_demo.duckdb",
                          cohort = "scid")
} # }
